mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.actor_id,x.try_payload FROM fulfillment_cancellation c JOIN allocation_execution x ON x.enterprise_id=c.enterprise_id AND x.attempt_id=c.attempt_id JOIN allocation_attempt a ON a.enterprise_id=c.enterprise_id AND a.id=c.attempt_id WHERE c.enterprise_id=#{e} AND c.attempt_id=#{a} AND (a.compensation_cancellation_id IS NULL OR c.id=a.compensation_cancellation_id) ORDER BY c.created_at,c.id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE fulfillment_cancellation SET state='COMPENSATING',version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND attempt_id=#{a} AND state='CANCEL_REQUESTED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fulfillment_cancellation_result(enterprise_id,attempt_id,warehouse_id,cancellation_id,state,payload,payload_hash,created_at) VALUES(#{r.e},#{r.a},#{r.w},#{r.id},#{r.state},CAST(#{r.payload} AS JSON),#{r.hash},UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE attempt_id=attempt_id
mapper.select: SELECT payload_hash FROM fulfillment_cancellation_result WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND attempt_id=#{a} AND warehouse_id=#{w}
mapper.update: UPDATE fulfillment_cancellation SET state=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fulfillment_cancellation_result r WHERE r.enterprise_id=#{e} AND r.attempt_id=#{a} AND r.state='PARTIALLY_COMPENSATED') THEN 'PARTIALLY_COMPENSATED' ELSE 'COMPLETED' END, version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND attempt_id=#{a} AND state='COMPENSATING' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM allocation_participant p WHERE p.enterprise_id=#{e} AND p.attempt_id=#{a} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fulfillment_cancellation_result r WHERE r.enterprise_id=p.enterprise_id AND r.attempt_id=p.attempt_id AND r.warehouse_id=p.warehouse_id))
mapper.select: SELECT id,attempt_id,client_operation_id,state,reason,version,updated_at FROM fulfillment_cancellation WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND fulfillment_id=#{o} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE allocation_attempt SET compensation_cancellation_id=#{id},version=version+1,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND id=#{a} AND compensation_cancellation_id IS NULL

UPDATE allocation_execution SET state='COMPENSATED',error_code=NULL,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND attempt_id=#{a} AND state='COMPENSATING' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fulfillment_cancellation c WHERE c.enterprise_id=#{e} AND c.attempt_id=#{a} AND c.state IN ('COMPLETED','PARTIALLY_COMPENSATED'))
